header: Five modules, with the planner at the centre
lead: Planning takes the most time, so it gets the most space. The other parts of Marlbrook Roster support it.

tiles.title: The planner
tiles.text: The week, the branch budget and every working-time rule on one screen. Copy last week forward, move what changed and publish to every phone. You see the cost while you plan.

tiles.title: Time recording
tiles.text: Tablet, phone or card reader, with an audit trail for every corrected minute.

tiles.title: Absence
tiles.text: Requests, approvals and staffing gaps in one list instead of three inboxes.

tiles.title: Payroll export
tiles.text: 12 formats, created from approved data instead of being retyped.

tiles.title: Reporting
tiles.text: Hours, cost and overtime per branch, per week, per contract type.
